verdict.rationale: Google's public plans page (one.google.com/about/plans) lists per-plan storage quotas of 100 GB and 2 TB, shared across Photos, Drive and Gmail, and says storage can be shared with up to 5 others. That is a first-party published quota tier structure. A community comment cites an old price point ($20/year for storage), but it is not from an official page and may be outdated. missing for 10: official price figures on the evidenced page, per-user (Workspace) pricing, documentation of what happens when the storage cap is reached, independent corroboration of current pricing.
